checks.message: Provisional geometry is explicitly labelled and never presented as an official redline.
All three key areas retain provisional precision and official_boundary=false.
Concept land-use polygons fully cover the submitted work boundary without material gaps or overlaps.
Known spatial metrics cite source files, formulas, confidence and assumptions; unsupported controls are unknown.
Chinese and English proposals, figures, HTML and PDFs are standalone counterparts.
Visual pages are offline static HTML with local assets and no remote scripts, fonts, maps, APIs or tracking.
A3 and A0 PDFs contain rendered pages in both languages and are subject to visual QA.
External cases are mechanism references only and do not become local controls, partners or promises.
All unapproved spatial, engineering, policy and operating decisions are framed as conceptual recommendations.
